2609.40087.title: MeanVoiceFlow2: Joint Optimization of Mean Flow and Content Encoder for Fast One-Step Zero-Shot Voice Conversion
2609.40087.paper_summary: Flow-matching approaches to voice conversion (VC) have gained attention owing to their high speech quality and strong speaker similarity. Among them, one-step models such as MeanVoiceFlow are particularly attractive because they enable efficient inference; however, their reliance on a computationally intensive content encoder remains a bottleneck. We therefore propose MeanVoiceFlow2, a framework that jointly optimizes a flow-based conversion module and a computationally efficient content encoder. The model is trained through conversion distillation using MeanVoiceFlow and the reconstruction of real data. We further incorporate diffusion-GAN training with sample mixing and teacher-guided conditioning augmentation to enhance realism and disentanglement. Experiments on zero-shot VC showed that MeanVoiceFlow2 achieved higher perceptual quality and approximately $9\times$ faster inference than MeanVoiceFlow while maintaining comparable speaker similarity. Audio samples are available at https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/meanvoiceflow2/.
2609.40087.paper_summary_zh: 流匹配方法在語音轉換（VC）方面受到關注，因為它們具有高語音質量和強烈的說話者相似性。<lb/>在這些方法中，像 MeanVoiceFlow 這樣的一步模型特別吸引人，因為它們能夠實現高效推斷；然而，它們對計算密集型內容編碼器的依賴仍然是一個瓶頸。<lb/>因此，我們提出了 MeanVoiceFlow2，一個共同優化基於流的轉換模塊和計算高效內容編碼器的框架。<lb/>該模型通過使用 MeanVoiceFlow 的轉換蒸餾和實際數據的重建進行訓練。<lb/>我們進一步結合了擴散生成對抗網絡（diffusion-GAN）訓練，通過樣本混合和教師引導的條件增強來提高真實感和解耦性。<lb/>在零樣本 VC 的實驗中顯示，MeanVoiceFlow2 在保持相似的說話者相似性的同時，實現了更高的感知質量和約 $9\times$ 更快的推斷速度，相較於 MeanVoiceFlow。<lb/>音頻樣本可在 https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/meanvoiceflow2/ 獲得。
